minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  May 13, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:40 a.m.

  Members Present: Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Debbie Crenshaw, Treasure’s Department
  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Angela Williams, Public Works Department

1. The minutes of April 29, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. A-Throne - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended settlement
  payment of $425.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. CultureNow - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $500.00. Motion carried unanimously.

4. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:43 a.m.

Adjournment
